title: Learning to Reason as Action Abstractions with Scalable Mid-Training RL

rs.key_step: 以跨多行保持的latent intention替代每token重推理；RL发现是否生成comment，再NTP蒸馏专家code+latent。
rs.why_non_obvious: 将推理生成频率作为可优化自由度，兼顾动作压缩与后续RL可学性。
rs.trigger_condition: When dense rationales make mid-training costly, learn temporally persistent abstractions and distill them with expert actions.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When dense rationales make mid-training costly, learn temporally persistent abstractions and distill them with expert actions.

signatures.operation: 交替E步RL学latent和M步NTP学code；think收固定cost
signatures.failure_boundary: 只code实验；小c过度think，大c=.2退化NTP，缺乏任务成功奖励校准。

relevance.how: mid-training先教可选推理/执行行为再RL，需改为caption/crop轨迹。
以loglikelihood收益是否超过cost控制think频率，非直接工具价值。
